name: Premier Marketing Public Co. Ltd. NVDR
summary: Premier Marketing Public Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, and distribution of consumer goods. The firm’s products include snacks, confectionery, food and beverages, nutrition, food and supplements, and personal care. It operates through the following segments: Distribution of Consumer Products, Manufacture of Food, and Cold Storage Warehouse and Services. The company was founded on July 28, 1977 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
